links.outcome: Clinically meaningful omissions in LLM summaries surfaced by automated omission detector, confirmed by blinded clinicians
links.effect: Mean 5.6 clinician-confirmed meaningful omissions per summary for OmitEHR vs 3.3 for a full LLM pipeline (25 admissions, two clinicians, at least one confirming).
links.quote: In a blinded review of 25 admissions, two board-certified clinicians confirmed a mean of 5.6 clinically meaningful omissions per summary surfaced by OmitEHR, compared with 3.3 for a full LLM pipeline, counting candidates confirmed by at least one clinician.

unlisted_practices: Reference-free omission detection trained on historical clinician-written summaries to flag omissions in LLM-generated hospital course summaries

screen.reason: Evaluates OmitEHR as an automated safety guardrail to detect and flag omissions in LLM-generated clinical summaries before delivery to clinicians.

primary.practice: automated omission detection / output filtering before clinician review
